item.text:
The product page now renders **Premium Widget** before requesting live inventory. Stock and price load inside a Suspense boundary, with “Loading inventory...” shown in the meantime. See [app/product/page.tsx](/workspace/app/product/page.tsx:15).

`npm run build` passed and confirmed that Next.js prerenders the title and streams the inventory section separately.
